result.title: PACT: Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-Graphs for Dynamic Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization
result.summary: Multi-agent approaches have been investigated recently as a means of improving the scalability of reinforcement learning for neural combinatorial optimization. Existing methods assume that all problem instance information is known upfront. However, real-world problems are often dynamic: relevant information is progressively revealed as the agents take actions (e.g., arriving at an edge in a routing problem only to discover it is untraversable). In such cases, existing methods fail to coordinate agents to explore and exploit the progressively revealed information. To address the arising coordination challenge, we introduce PACT (Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-graphs). PACT augments the environment graph with auxiliary nodes representing the plans of agents, which are connected to the resource nodes to indicate future dependencies. The proposed message-passing scheme over the augmented graph grounds inter-agent coordination in the environment and enables proactive, rather than reactive, conflict resolution. We show that PACT improves solution quality in dynamic problems relative to baselines and exhibits the best transfer to larger instances on which, remarkably, it outperforms centralized oracles with privileged access to instance uncertainty.

AI.brief_summary: PACT 针对信息逐步揭示的动态多智能体组合优化问题，在环境图中加入表示智能体计划的辅助节点以指示未来依赖，并通过增广图上的消息传递实现主动式冲突协调，在动态路由任务上提升解质量并更好地迁移到更大实例。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把计划作为显式辅助节点编码未来依赖、以主动而非被动方式协调」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 工作区的证据获取与前瞻性决策提供概念线索，是否可迁移到多模态推理状态尚待核查。
